$comment: Zulu — survey screen text (ui) and instrument translations (items, keyed by item key; instrument v4). ui status: machine-draft. Items here override the instrument's own text; empty means the language has no question translations yet. Edit via the translation sheet (docs/TRANSLATION.md).

ui.done_pending: Izimpendulo zakho zigcinwe kule foni futhi zizongezwa esithombeni se-{org} lapho kuba nesiginali — akudingeki wenze lutho.
ui.done_private: Babona imiphumela ehlanganisiwe kuphela, hhayi izimpendulo zomuntu ngamunye.
ui.done_saved: Impendulo yakho isengezwe esithombeni se-{org} sokuthi umphakathi wabo ulandela kanjani uJesu.
ui.install_android: Faka inhlolovo ye-{org} kule foni ukuze ivuleke ngaphandle kwesiginali.
ui.install_ios: Thepha inkinobho ethi Yabelana, bese uthi “Engeza Esikrinini Sasekhaya”, ukuze ivuleke ngaphandle kwesiginali.
ui.no_org_body: Ayikho inhlangano kuleli kheli. Hlola isixhumanisi osinikiwe — kungenzeka sinephutha, noma sisusiwe.
ui.not_fielding_community: {org} ayikavuli le nhlolovo. Uma othile esabelane nawe ngayo, mtshele ukuthi isixhumanisi asikasebenzi.
ui.not_fielding_note: Akukho okwenzayo lapha okuqoshwayo, ngoba akukho lapho kungaqoshwa khona.
ui.not_fielding_public: {org} ayikavuli inhlolovo yayo yomphakathi. Uma othile esabelane nawe ngayo, mtshele ukuthi isixhumanisi asikasebenzi.
ui.offline_banner_body: Izimpendulo zakho zigcinwa kule foni futhi zithunyelwa ngokwazo lapho isiginali ibuya.
ui.offline_first_body: Le nhlolovo idinga isiginali okokuqala ivulwa efonini. Ngemuva kwalokho isebenza ngaphandle kwesiginali. Zama futhi uma usuxhunyiwe.
ui.preview_banner: Ukubuka kuqala kokuhumusha okusalungiswa — izimpendulo aziqoshwa.
ui.type_here: Bhala okuningi noma okuncane ngendlela othanda ngayo…
ui.welcome_body: {org} ifuna ukufunda ukuhamba nabasha njengoba belandela uJesu. Izimpendulo zakho eziqotho ziyasiza. Kuthatha cishe imizuzu engu-{minutes} futhi akuvezi ukuthi ungubani.
